candidate_workaround: Load the route contract through the evidence-pinned reader whenever the current worktree has advanced beyond the evidence state.
failure_signature: The first 62-test pre-seal selection passed sixty-one tests and failed the x2 route assertion because it read the later closeout route from the mutable worktree instead of the frozen evidence commit.
recurrence_guard: Lifecycle tests must read every phase-mutating artifact from the commit whose state they claim to validate.
rollback: Give the failed assertion no closeout credit, retain it, and rely only on the corrected bounded witness.
scope_boundary: Bounded same-owner closeout recovery only; no independent reproduction or authority credit.
title: Recover evidence_route_read_from_mutable_worktree without erasing its failed witness
